'''Kav-Dann power armor''', also called '''Kav-Dann series power armor''', was a body armor designed to be used in high-risk combat situations. It was created by [[Nubian]] engineers on the planet [[Nubia/Legends|Nubia]] and given its name in reference to the native predatory reptiles [[Kav-Dann]]s. The bulky and intimidating armor was fully sealed, which made it impervious to exterior environments, including [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. The armor included a [[Life support/Legends|life-support]] system that could be modified for most alien physiologies. The armor was intended for sale to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], but the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] presence on Nubia prevented distribution of the suit.<ref name="Keeping the Peace" />
